title: ALT–waist coupling does not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of fasting insulin
abstract: In exploratory transfer from NHANES 2015–2016 (1,682 adults) to 2017–2018 (1,722), an ALT–waist interaction reduced weighted log-insulin prediction MSE by 0.002773 (1.23%); the joint source/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval for added-minus-baseline MSE was -0.008293 to +0.003337. Incremental benefit was not established.
